stem: A key safety limit emphasized for acetaminophen from all sources is which daily maximum?

options.label: A
options.text: 4000 mg per day from all sources
options.misconception: None; do not exceed 4000 mg/day from all sources.
options.explanation: MedlinePlus: do not take more than 4000 mg of acetaminophen per day from all sources.

options.label: B
options.text: Only 4 mg if taken with warfarin
options.misconception: Wrong drug and dose — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: C
options.text: 400 mg per day from all sources
options.misconception: Tenfold underdose of the stated limit.
options.explanation: Wrong magnitude; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: 40 g per day from all sources
options.explanation: Wrong magnitude; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: No upper limit if used for fever only
options.misconception: Unsafe claim — does not match the cited teaching point.
